title: cng2026
description:
A global catalog of points of interest for choosing where to build a
mini Major TOM dataset. Pick a class, such as volcanoes, glaciers or solar
power plants, and use its points to decide which locations to download from
public satellite archives.

The points come from [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org) and are released
under [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), so the file
can be copied, filtered and redistributed without restrictions.
